sensitivity_context.purpose: Correction of data/experiments/power_analysis_wilcoxon_n48_sensitivity.json. That artifact and PR #53 counted 5 EEN-sourced records that pass ADR 0003 origin verification but were never checked against the pre-registered content-completeness inclusion criterion (docs/empirical-study-protocol.md §4.1: substantive technical problem description, minimum 25 words). Those 5 EEN detail pages carry no free-text description (verified via direct fetch and rendered-browser inspection) and no alternative public description was found for 4 of them; the 5th's only substantive description lives on the Lombardia mirror and was already counted there. Corrected available N = 41 (InnoGet) + 2 (Lombardia) = 43, 0 from EEN. See docs/phase2-demand-acquisition-audit.md and docs/phase2-sample-size-amendment.md for the full correction record.
